opening.label: 15 December 1419 · after the year’s turning points

briefing: Rouen has surrendered and John the Fearless has been killed at Montereau; Philip the Good succeeds in Burgundy. English control of Rouen and substantial Norman positions does not establish rule over all France. Burgundian policy is shifting after Montereau; the Treaty of Troyes is not already concluded.
